text:
Maria: FYI — Support received an escalation from AcmeCorp: sudden 5xx increase on hosted inference API (us-west-2) starting ~03:12 UTC. Customers seeing a mix of 503s and 504s plus long tail timeouts. Some report duplicate billing due to client retries.

Jamal: Oncall here. Any correlation IDs or sample request IDs we can look up? Also which deploy/flag rolled out around 03:10?

Maria: Paste of short metrics: 503 rate jumped from 0.4% -> 18% in 3m. P95 latency from 120ms -> 2.4s. Errors concentrated on the /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings routes. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/hosted?panel=503-spike (short link)

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — runtime-service v0.3.2 -> v0.3.3 at 03:10 UTC. Traffic fraction: 20%.

Alex: Stack change in v0.3.3 flipped a config flag enable_kv_prefetch=true and bumped the batching knob default. I pushed the change to reduce cold-start cost but didn't expect this pattern.

Cheng: Looking at runtime logs, KV cache misses exploded and backend fetch latency spiked. A few workers logged OOM-ish traces before connection resets. Example log snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T03:12:17Z runtime[worker-7]: kvcache: miss storm, inflight_fetches=238
2026-03-17T03:12:18Z runtime[worker-7]: backend_timeout after 5.0s, upstream_error=504
2026-03-17T03:12:19Z runtime[worker-7]: grpc: server stopped responding, closing stream
```

Jamal: Ok, cadence: pause the canary and rollback v0.3.3 from routing. Can someone run the routing command? Also grab a couple of request IDs to forward to platform-storage for trace lookups.

Alex: Running rollback now — calling ops runbook command: 
```
/ops rollback-canary runtime-service v0.3.3 --to-traffic 0%
```

Alex: rollback issued at 03:18 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary routing for runtime-service v0.3.3 set to 0% at 03:19 UTC. Traffic routed back to v0.3.2.

Cheng: After rollback we see p95 trending back down; 503 rate falling from 18% -> 2.1% in ~4m. Still monitoring for residual errors.

Maria: Sent initial customer note to Acme support contact explaining we paused the canary and are investigating. Asking them to hold off retries; suggested backoff.

Sara: I'll draft the outage blurb & open a postmortem ticket. Assigning to Alex/Cheng for root cause and to Jamal for mitigation notes.

Jamal: Action items: (1) Alex to revert enable_kv_prefetch change and run local repro with traffic replay; (2) Cheng to collect heap + kernel stats from affected nodes; (3) Platform to add guardrail: fail fast on kvcache miss storm. Please add any other notes.

Maria: Thanks — keeping this thread as the escalation channel. I'll update customers once we have RCA scope. :thumbsup:
